About Sterlix Surgical

For over 20 years we have crafted surgical instruments for general surgery, orthopedics, ENT and gynecology. Our skilled craftsmen combine traditional hand finishing with precision CNC and laser inspection.

Our goal is simple: instruments that feel balanced in the hand, hold an edge, and survive thousands of sterilization cycles.
